node.statement: Assembly. Under the hypotheses of node 1, use the universal L,e_env of node 1.1. Node 1.2 proves the asserted c_0^cb*epsilon-projection statement for every nonempty U and supplies the nonvanishing hypothesis; node 1.3 then proves the extended L*epsilon-C*-algebra statement for every A_U=S^A_{P_U}; node 1.4 proves every stated subordination and complementarity estimate for every U subseteq R. These statements are exactly all clauses of the root contract, using only the registered definitions, lem-maincb-error-improvement for its universal c_0^cb witness, and lem-compcb-corner-algebra for the compressed-corner conclusion.
